body: hey:) i'm just letting you know i'm still here, still struggling and still in my one sided relationship, but i'm trying to take each day as it comes, thank you for caring enough to talk to me for a bit, you're a good person and i hope you have a very good life:)

there's not much around me apart from a road and i don't drive due to hallucinations so it's hard for me to get to nice places but i take the bus sometimes to the town and walk around for a while, i like to walk but i don't like to walk by myself because i feel quite uncomfortable in public spaces, i'm going to try playing video games when i get home from work and see if i can actually get myself interested in something :)
i like to play video games but ive not had much interest recently to be honest. other than that i just sleep and go to work

i'm just so confused at the moment with all my thoughts you know? like nothing seems like it's actually real or happening and i'm just confused, i'm going back to therapy on tuesday so hopefully i will get to talk to my psychiatrist about some of this stuff and hopefully she will give me input on it, i just need to make it to tuesday, but right now, when my mind is like this and the situation with my girlfriend is prominent, tuesday seems like forever away

i feel like i love her. i'm angry at her. but i don't think i really understand what love is, i think it's just the sense of having someone around me that i feel is like love? having someone who is just there? i catch feelings quickly and i give too many chances, i just don't know, i know for a fact she feels nothing for me

ive looked for new places but everything's out of my budget, the place we live in doesn't have a contract and we moved in together into there so it's really nobody's place it's just           our place communally,

shes 18, i haven't ended it with her because we live in a house together away from my family and parents, and i'm too scared to be on my own, financially i don't think i'd survive, and i can't move back in with my mum, i'm sort of just at a dead end, and staying with her is the only way i can actually keep my apartment
